test_title: SSC CGL Tier 2 English Previous Paper 1 (Held on: 8 Aug 2022)
subject: english
question:
**Select the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence.**

Jayesh said to Diwakar, "You can top the class if you want to."

options.text: Jayesh told Diwakar that he would top the class if he wants to.
Jayesh told Diwakar that he could top the class if he wanted to.
Jayesh told Diwakar that you could top the class if you wanted to.
Jayesh told Diwakar that you can top the class if you want to.

solution:
The correct answer is **Jayesh told Diwakar that he could top the class if he wanted to.**

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] __Key Points__**

 
• As the reporting verb is in the **past** tense**, '**can' will be changed to **'**could', and **'**want' will be changed to **'**wanted'.
 
• 'Said to' changes to **'**told' in indirect speech. 
 
• While converting a direct speech into indirect speech, the second person pronoun '**you'** changes according to the object of Reporting Verb.
 
• Here, the object of reporting verb is **Diwakar, **hence, **'****you' **has been replaced by **'****he' **in reported speech.
 
• Thus, the most appropriate indirect form of the given sentence is expressed in **option 2**.
 
• The correct indirect form of the given sentence is **Jayesh told Diwakar that he could top the class if he wanted to.**
